behavior.name: 0x130014bc
behavior.description: A box that remains hidden and intangible until the nearest bhvFloorSwitchHiddenObjects enter the PURPLE_SWITCH_ACT_TICKING state. Depending on the 'sBox Type's, it either executes hidden_breakable_box_actions or hidden_unbreakable_box_actions. Unbreakable variants disappear after 400 frames (360 wait + 40 blink).
